description: Catalog of all analytical-output schemas. The C++ helper (common/tessera-analytical-io.{h,cpp}) and the Python wrapper (tools/tessera/_analytical_io.py) both look up schema files by the `name` field below. Adding a new analytical output is: drop a new <name>.schema.json in this directory, add an entry here, then list it in the SCHEMA_NAMES array in common/tessera-analytical-io.cpp.

schemas.name: l4_probe
schemas.produces: l4 e2e probe (synthetic: tools/tessera/l5_demo.py; real: C++ L4 probe, when landed)
